summary:
{
  "ledger": [
    "Mirror and frame | Large rectangular gold-brown frame on the wall, viewed obliquely over the man's shoulder | Same position and orientation | One continuous camera angle; the frame consistently bounds the reflected room and crops the reflected torso at its lower edge.",
    "Wooden door and white trim | In the reflected background, left of the man and shelving; brass knob near the right edge of the door | Same arrangement | Moving foreground head and arm intermittently obscure portions of the door; no room beyond the door is established.",
    "Wall and switch plate | Pale reflected wall between the door trim and shelving; rectangular plate left of the reflected head | Same location relative to trim and shelving | The man's head and shoulder change how much wall is visible without relocating its features.",
    "Shelving and bottles | Dark wooden shelves behind and to the right of the reflected man, containing small bottles | Same background position and shelf arrangement | The reflected head and shoulder occlude portions of the shelves and bottles; background objects remain behind him.",
    "Man and reflection | Direct rear/side view occupies the left foreground; frontal reflection occupies the right half of the mirror | Same spatial relationship | Head tilts and upper-body movements remain compatible with the single oblique mirror view; the foreground body occludes the mirror while the reflected body occludes the reflected room.",
    "Moving hand, forearm, and grooming tool | Raised between the man and mirror near his lower face | Raised near his upper face | Repeated upward and downward sweeps cross the face in reflection and obscure the reflected background; no definite penetration of fixed surfaces or reversed depth ordering is visible."
  ],
  "findings": []
}
